verdict.rationale: Docs state you can 'schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep your data fresh' and refresh as often as every minute, indicating recurring job/workflow scheduling support. However, details are thin — no documentation on schedule configuration (cron-like syntax, timezone, pause/resume), no UI/API endpoint specifics for managing schedules, and no independent or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: scheduling API/UI details, configuration options, independent verification of reliability at scale.
